reviewScope: Gu Drag Right only, eight suspended-sway frames; no other direction or character

selfReview.method: Inspected all eight PNGs in native contact sheet and 4x collar/elbow/cuff/knee details on alternating light/dark backgrounds; checked adjacent silhouette displacements including 8-to-1.
selfReview.head: Exact Idle pixels at their original position, no head resizing, re-expression or new glasses.
selfReview.body: Original upper-body pixels travel together in small continuous integer scanline offsets. No torso/arm x-boundary cut and no shoulder widening.
selfReview.seams: No obvious detached limb, cuff gap, white fringe or color discontinuity observed in the inspected sheets.
selfReview.motion: All eight frames differ. Waist, hands and feet move, with a fixed neck anchor; no alternating floor-contact stride. Adjacent maximum displacement is 1-3 pixels, including loop closure.
selfReview.limitation: Continuous scanline displacement is a limited sway study, not a fully articulated physical rig. Whether the nape-lift reads naturally requires the user's GIF review.
selfReview.browserGifPlayback: NOT_VERIFIED: browser file URL action denied by security policy. No alternate browser or local-server workaround attempted.
